Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.14 makes game version strings non-gating: patch updates such as 1.0.0.15 keep loading instead of pausing existing saves, and the manifest version metadata is empty so the mod menu no longer shows a version-mismatch warning. The 1.13 mother household-goods and bail scheduling fixes, 1.12 harem bracelet fix, 1.11 portrait selector, 1.10 voice pass and earlier entry, hit-area and portrait-compatibility fixes remain. Simplified Chinese / English. 1.14 取消按游戏版本号停用剧情：1.0.0.15 等补丁更新后会继续加载，不再中断已有存档；manifest 版本元数据清空，模组菜单不再显示版本不匹配提示。保留 1.13 母亲日用品交易与保释调度修复、1.12 手镯修复、1.11 立绘选择、1.10 voice pass 与更早的入线、点击区、立绘兼容修复。简体中文 / English。
